title: Viewport Frame
description: Viewport Frame is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Draws the current viewport as a frame on the minimap. The frame maps the viewport rectangle into minimap coordinates and updates on every scroll. It takes viewport rect and produces minimap frame. Tunable parameters: updates per frame. Guarantee: the frame never lags more than one frame.

fields.mechanism: The frame maps the viewport rectangle into minimap coordinates and updates on every scroll.
fields.guarantees: the frame never lags more than one frame

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Click to Jump
description: Click to Jump is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Jumps the main view to wherever the minimap is clicked. Click coordinates are scaled back to world coordinates and the viewport centers there. It takes minimap click and produces jumped viewport. Tunable parameters: centered on click. Guarantee: jumps never lose the current zoom.

fields.mechanism: Click coordinates are scaled back to world coordinates and the viewport centers there.
fields.guarantees: jumps never lose the current zoom

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Node Density Dots
description: Node Density Dots is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Renders dense node regions as clustered dots instead of individual marks. Nodes are binned into minimap pixels; each pixel's brightness is the bin count. It takes node positions and produces density dots. Tunable parameters: 1 px bins. Guarantee: empty regions never glow.

fields.mechanism: Nodes are binned into minimap pixels; each pixel's brightness is the bin count.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Collaborator Pings
description: Collaborator Pings is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Shows each collaborator as a colored ping on the minimap. Viewport centers stream per user and render as pulsing dots in user colors. It takes viewport stream and produces pings. Tunable parameters: pulse 1 Hz. Guarantee: pings never show exact cursor positions.

fields.mechanism: Viewport centers stream per user and render as pulsing dots in user colors.
fields.guarantees: pings never show exact cursor positions

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Trail Playback
description: Trail Playback is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Leaves a fading trail of where the viewport has been. Viewport centers are recorded with timestamps; the trail fades over 60 seconds. It takes viewport history and produces trail. Tunable parameters: 60 s fade. Guarantee: trails never persist after the session.

fields.mechanism: Viewport centers are recorded with timestamps; the trail fades over 60 seconds.
fields.guarantees: trails never persist after the session

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Zoom Slider Sync
description: Zoom Slider Sync is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Keeps the minimap zoom box in sync with the main zoom control. Both controls write to one zoom state; the minimap box rescales instantly. It takes zoom state and produces synced box. Tunable parameters: single source of truth. Guarantee: the two can never disagree.

fields.mechanism: Both controls write to one zoom state; the minimap box rescales instantly.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Search Result Beacons
description: Search Result Beacons is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Flashes beacons on the minimap for every search hit. Hit positions are plotted as beacons that pulse until the user visits or dismisses them. It takes search hits and produces beacons. Tunable parameters: pulse until visited. Guarantee: beacons never outlive their search.

fields.mechanism: Hit positions are plotted as beacons that pulse until the user visits or dismisses them.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Minimap Filters
description: Minimap Filters is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Toggles which layers appear on the minimap. Each layer — nodes, edges, collaborators, hits — has a toggle; the minimap redraws on change. It takes layer toggles and produces filtered minimap. Tunable parameters: per-layer. Guarantee: filters never affect the main view.

fields.mechanism: Each layer — nodes, edges, collaborators, hits — has a toggle; the minimap redraws on change.
fields.guarantees: filters never affect the main view

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Overview Presets
description: Overview Presets is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Saves named minimap framings for one-click return. A preset stores center and zoom; clicking it animates the main view to match. It takes preset list and produces framed views. Tunable parameters: unlimited presets. Guarantee: presets survive reload.

fields.mechanism: A preset stores center and zoom; clicking it animates the main view to match.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Edge Glow
description: Edge Glow is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Glows edges that cross the viewport boundary on the minimap. Crossing edges are detected per frame and drawn brighter so connections stay visible. It takes edge list, viewport and produces glowing crossings. Tunable parameters: per-frame check. Guarantee: glow never exceeds the minimap bounds.

fields.mechanism: Crossing edges are detected per frame and drawn brighter so connections stay visible.
fields.guarantees: glow never exceeds the minimap bounds

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Mini Labels
description: Mini Labels is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Shows short labels on the minimap at high zoom only. Labels appear when the minimap zoom passes the label threshold and hide below it. It takes zoom level and produces labels. Tunable parameters: threshold zoom 4×. Guarantee: labels never overlap each other.

fields.mechanism: Labels appear when the minimap zoom passes the label threshold and hide below it.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Rotation Lock
description: Rotation Lock is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Keeps the minimap north-up even when the main view rotates. The minimap renders in world coordinates while the main view may rotate freely. It takes view rotation and produces stable minimap. Tunable parameters: north-up fixed. Guarantee: the viewport frame rotates instead.

fields.mechanism: The minimap renders in world coordinates while the main view may rotate freely.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Export Snapshot
description: Export Snapshot is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Exports the current minimap as a PNG thumbnail. The minimap canvas is serialized at 2× resolution with the viewport frame included. It takes canvas state and produces PNG file. Tunable parameters: 2× resolution. Guarantee: exports always include the legend.

fields.mechanism: The minimap canvas is serialized at 2× resolution with the viewport frame included.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Keyboard Pan
description: Keyboard Pan is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Pans the main view from the minimap with arrow keys. With the minimap focused, arrows nudge the viewport frame and the main view follows. It takes key events and produces panned view. Tunable parameters: nudge 10% of view. Guarantee: focus is always visible.

fields.mechanism: With the minimap focused, arrows nudge the viewport frame and the main view follows.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Auto-Hide
description: Auto-Hide is a navigation ability in the Contextual Minimap Overviews database. Hides the minimap when the workspace fits entirely on screen. If the world bounds fit the viewport at zoom 1, the minimap collapses to a small button. It takes world bounds, viewport and produces collapsed button. Tunable parameters: auto. Guarantee: the button always restores the minimap.

fields.mechanism: If the world bounds fit the viewport at zoom 1, the minimap collapses to a small button.
fields.guarantees: the button always restores the minimap

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.
